plan: Implement the worldview canvas panel: non-character StoryEntity nodes (location/organization/faction/item/species/rule/ability/term) clustered by kind on InfiniteCanvas, EntityRelation edges (both endpoints non-character), drag-to-connect, context menu, entity editor drawer with kind selector, add-entity modal with kind picker. Wire into NovelStudio LibraryWorkspace (mode='worldview').
actions: Created WorldviewNodeContent.tsx: pure presentational component for non-character entity node body. Shows kind-colored GlobalOutlined icon, entity name, kind Tag (with per-kind color: location=#13c2c2, organization=#722ed1, faction=#eb2f96, item=#fa8c16, species=#52c41a, rule=#f5222d, ability=#2f54eb, term=#8c8c8c), summary (falls back to description then '尚未定义'), up to 3 tags. Includes data-worldview-node attribute for edge drop targeting.

Created WorldviewCanvasPanel.tsx: full panel with kind-cluster layout. Filters entities to non-character kinds (kind !== 'character'). Custom worldviewLayout function: 4-column grid of kind clusters (CLUSTER_COLS=4, CLUSTER_WIDTH=360, CLUSTER_HEIGHT=360, ROW_SPACING=170), each cluster stacks nodes vertically. kindIndexMap and indexInCluster computed via useMemo. Edges filtered to both-endpoints-non-character EntityRelation. Default relation type '关联'. AddEntityModal with kind picker (8 non-character kinds). Entity editor Drawer: name, kind, summary, description, tags. Context menu, keyboard shortcuts, minimap, zoom controls, container size tracking.

Created WorldviewCanvasPanel.test.tsx: 10 SSR tests. 7 for WorldviewNodeContent (name/kind/summary, kind tag, tags, description fallback, empty fallback '尚未定义', organization kind label, data-worldview-node attribute). 3 for WorldviewCanvasPanel (header '世界观设定图'/'WORLDVIEW CANVAS'/'添加设定'/'建立关联', empty state '还没有设定'/'创建第一个设定', undo/redo buttons).

Wired WorldviewCanvasPanel into NovelStudio.tsx: added lazy import, added 'worldview' to LibraryWorkspace mode state type, added Segmented option { value: 'worldview', label: '世界观' }, added canvas case in main content ternary, skip GenerationComposer for worldview mode (null).

Fixed tsc error: KIND_OPTIONS label lookup object didn't include 'character' key, causing TS2339 when indexing with EntityKind. Extracted KIND_LABEL as Record<EntityKind, string> to satisfy type checker.
Ran vitest: 16 test files, 128 tests passed (10 new worldview + 118 existing). Ran tsc --noEmit: exit 0, no errors.

verification.summary: vitest run: 16 test files passed, 128 tests passed, 0 failed. Worldview tests: WorldviewCanvasPanel.test.tsx (10 tests) all pass.
tsc --noEmit: exit 0. All worldview canvas files type-check cleanly. NovelStudio.tsx wiring is correct.

selfReflection: Loop 6 implemented the worldview canvas panel with kind-cluster layout. The custom layoutStrategy function pattern (established in loop 5 for timeline) worked well here too — kindIndexMap and indexInCluster are precomputed via useMemo, then the layout function closes over them. The per-kind color scheme (KIND_COLOR in WorldviewNodeContent) gives visual distinction between clusters. Edges reuse EntityRelation but filtered to both-endpoints-non-character, keeping character↔character edges in the character panel and character↔non-character edges excluded from both panels (those relations exist in the DB but aren't shown on either canvas — a deliberate design choice since cross-panel edges would require shared viewport state). The AddEntityModal with kind picker is a natural UX addition since worldview encompasses 8 entity kinds. The useCanvasPanel hook's saved-position restoration fix (from loop 5) benefits this panel too. Three of four panels are now complete; only planning-canvas-panel remains.

selfAssessment.reason: Worldview canvas panel is fully implemented and verified with 10 passing tests. The kind-cluster layout and per-kind coloring provide clear visual grouping. No blockers for the final planning canvas panel.
